tei:div.tei:p: "!#: yi dam rtsa gsum dril sgrub bzhugs so:

rgya gar skad du: gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī: bod skad du: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: rtsa ba gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs las can don du ni: rtsa ba gsum gyi sgrub thabs bstan: 'di la spyi don rnam pa gsum: sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gsum mo: sbyor ba gsum la skyabs 'gro dang: sems bskyed gsol ba gdab pa 'o: skyabs 'gro sgo gsum yid dad pas: bla ma yi dam ḍā ki'i tshogs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du: rtsa ba gsum po bsgrubs nas kyang: gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca 'o: gsol 'debs sgo gsum yid dad pas: rang gi spyi bor rta mgrin dang: de yi spyi bor bla ma dang: phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhi la: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskyed: mos gus cher bskyed mchi ma dbyung: hūm̐ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams: padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: rtsa ba gsum gyi rang bzhin la: bdag gzhan gus pas gsol ba 'debs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub zhu: gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa ma ya hūm̐ ā: dngos gzhi la gsum ste: bskyed rim dang: sngags bzlas: rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o: dang po chos rnams dmigs med las: padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du: bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: rta mgrin dbang chen sku mdog dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyi bo'i gtsug: rta mgo rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: phyag g.yas dbang sdud gri gug bsnams: phyag g.yon thod khrag bdud rtsi gsol: dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: rus pa'i rgyan drug kha ṭwāṃ bsnams: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud bzhi brdzis: nyi zla pad steng 'gying zhing brjid: g.yon pas rdo rje phag mor 'khyud: cha lugs yab 'dra spyi bo'i gtsug: phag zhal mthing kha ngur sgra sgrog:

gzhon tshul nu ma bha ga rgyas: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs: 'od zer rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa 'phro: de nyid spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng: padma ge sar snying po la: gu ru rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje sems dpa'i cha lugs su: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: gcer bu spyan gsum rus rgyan mdzes: phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar bsnams: phyag g.yon dril bu yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: de phang g.yon du rig ma ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: bcu drug lon pa'i gzhon tshul can: pad mdog nu ma bha ga rgyas: rin chen rus rgyan cod pan can: phyag g.yas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: phyag g.yon thod pa bdud rtsi stob: zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril: sku mdog dkar po 'dzum mdangs can: gcer bu 'od dang ldan par bsam: bdag nyid rta mgrin du gsal ba'i klad pa dung khang du: rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum dkar: mgrin par rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum ser: snying gar buddha yab yum mthing: lte bar padma yab yum dmar: gsang bar las kyi ḍā ki yab yum ljang 'khor lo lngar rtsa 'dab bzhi bzhir gtso 'khor lnga lnga bskyed : sku mdog rigs la phyag mtshan dang po dang mthun par g.yas gri gug g.yon dung dmar rtsa: so so'i thugs kar rang srog thugs kar hrīḥm/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gnyis ra ha/ rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum tsa ri sogs mtshan: de las 'od 'phros 'jig rten khams: rtsa gsum gzhal yas khang du bskyed: bcud kyi sems can thams cad kun: rtsa ba gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro du bskyed byas la: sngags bzlas pa yi rim pa ni: snying po 'di la 'bad de bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sku gsung thugs : badzra rdo rje gu ru bla ma padma mtshan thod phreng rtsal gsang mtshan : hrīḥm ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya dpa' bo ging : tsitta hrīng hrīng dzaḥdza snying nas drangs shinga'agugs

: siddhi pha la hūm̐ ā dngos grub stsol : grangs bsnyen 'bum du bzla bar bya: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga thams cad sngags sgra 'u ru ru: mtshan bzang byung na chos bshad/ dbang bskur/ sems ngo sprod pa gzhan don nus: de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni: de ltar gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: du mar snang yang ngang du gcig: rang nyid rang la rang nyid lha: rang dang lhan cig skyes pa la: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med pas: spyan drangs bzhugs gsol 'dir mi dgos: sems nyid rang las byung zhing rang dbang bskur: gdod ma nas rang sems bla ma yi dam lha ru gnas: dbang dang rab gnas bya mi dgos: 'dod pa'i yon tan mang po yang: sems kyi rang snang ye shes rol pa'i rgyan du shar : rang las sprul cing rang mchod pas: mchod pa gzhan gyis bskang mi 'tshal: snang srid gzhal yas bla ma lha: dkyil 'khor chen por lhun gyis grub: dper na chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: snang la rang bzhin med par gnas: 'dzin pas ma bcings ma bcos pa'i ngang la gsal bar bsgom: rjes la nyams chag bskang ba dang: smon lam gdab cing dge ba bsngo: dang po spyi gtsug pad steng du: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: sku mdog shel 'dra'i thugs ka ru: zla steng hūm̐ la yig brgyas bskor: de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun tshang bug nas mar babs pas: bdag gi nyams chag sdig dag par: bsam zhing yi ge brgya par satwa'i shul du gu ru gzhug pa bzlas: nyams chag thams 1$0000290cad bskang bar 'gyur: de rjes kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i: ngang la yid ni dran med bzhag: nyams chag rang gi ngo bo stong: ka dag yon tan ngang gis rdzogs: gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa ni: e ma hoḥ bdag gis 'gro ba kun don du: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar: lus ngag yid gsum dge spyad pa: rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i phrin las kyis: kun mkhyen ye shes mchog thob shog: gsum pa gzhan don bsngo ba ni:

phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas dang: bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs byas nas: dus gsum pha mas sna drangs pa'i: 'gro drug sems can ma lus kun: bla ma mchog gis bzung nas kyang: yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog: lan gsum bsngo ba thebs par gdab: bsngo bya sngo byed bsngo rgyu ste: 'khor gsum dmigs med ngang la bzhag: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lam: rtsa ba gsum gyi dril sgrub 'di: o rgyan/kapadma 'byung gnas kyis: ye shes mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams kyi don: 'di yis 'grub kyi gter du sbos: bdag 'dra ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis: byar phug rdo rje'i brag la gtams: dus mthar gter bdag brla sme can: bden bral phyogs su gdan 'dren 'gyur: rtsa gsum dril sgrub man ngag rdzogs so: gu hyaḥ rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku ratna gling pas gdan drangs pa'o// //
